import re

# Test different patterns
pattern1 = r'(.+?) *'  # current
pattern2 = r'(\S+) *'  # proposed for left align
pattern3 = r'(\s*\S+\s*)'  # for center align

test_str = 'hello world foo bar'

print('Pattern 1 (.+?):')
for m in re.finditer(pattern1, test_str):
    print(f'  {m.group()!r} at {m.start()}-{m.end()}')

print('Pattern 2 (\\S+):')
for m in re.finditer(pattern2, test_str):
    print(f'  {m.group()!r} at {m.start()}-{m.end()}')

print('Pattern 3 (\\s*\\S+\\s*):')
for m in re.finditer(pattern3, test_str):
    print(f'  {m.group()!r} at {m.start()}-{m.end()}')
